Q6111.reason: The ordinance is content-neutral and serves an important interest unrelated to suppressing expression, so it satisfies the O'Brien test for incidental burdens on symbolic speech.

Q5735.reason: Only a defendant can remove a case, so the plaintiff's removal was improper and the whole case is remanded.

Q5651.reason: An 'as is' clause does not disclaim an express warranty created by the ad and picture, such as the 1964 model year, so Carol likely wins.
